_note: Register fragment for theme-archive-hotspot (REQ-THA-001). An administrator marks a subject as an archive hotspot, with the reason; ThemeHotspotGuard stamps archiveHotspotSince and sets the subject's OpenRegister appraisal to permanent. No later fragment in name order declares the theme schema, so this one carries its version bump. The publication inherits the appraisal of its themes through OpenRegister (REQ-THA-002); its version is the merged one, so woo-x-access-boundary-hardening.json, last in name order, carries the same bump.

archiveHotspot.title: Archive hotspot
archiveHotspot.description: Every publication filed under this subject is kept permanently.
